mapper.sql: select d.draft_id, d.note_id, d.item_id, d.title, d.content, d.tags, d.is_public, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_time, i.title as item_name from sgj_note_draft d left join sgj_item i on i.item_id = d.item_id
mapper.select: select d.draft_id, d.note_id, d.item_id, d.title, d.tags, d.is_public, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_time, i.title as item_name, concat(substring(d.content, 1, 600), if(char_length(d.content) > 600, '…', '')) as excerpt_src from sgj_note_draft d left join sgj_item i on i.item_id = d.item_id where d.create_by = #{createBy} order by d.update_time desc, d.draft_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into sgj_note_draft (note_id, item_id, title, content, tags, is_public, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{noteId}, #{itemId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{tags}, #{isPublic}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update sgj_note_draft set note_id = #{noteId}, item_id = #{itemId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, tags = #{tags}, is_public = #{isPublic}, update_time = sysdate() where draft_id = #{draftId}
